note.question: How do digital platforms often share publicly visible behavioral data, such as ratings and reviews, to improve service quality?
note.overview: Digital platforms often share publicly visible behavioral data, such as ratings and reviews, to improve service quality. Yet, these seemingly innocuous data can also reveal hidden social ties among users. The paper develops a two-stage framework that first diagnoses this leakage risk by inferring latent social interactions from behavioral data and then mitigates the risk while preserving data utility.
